# Rohit Builds

> Personal brand portfolio by Rohit Bhandari — an Azure Data Engineer building learning tools and AI projects. The home page is the careers page; passion projects live on their own pages.

This file is a lightweight index for LLMs and AI agents. Full site content in llms-full.txt.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/): Rohit's careers/portfolio page — "Designing data platforms that are readable, reliable, and ready to scale." Azure Data Engineer evolving into a platform-minded architect.
- [News](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/news/): Flagship — curated AI news portal with dated, editorial editions.
- [Shop](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/shop/): Flagship — storefront project.
- [Portfolio (legacy)](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/portfolio/): Redirects to Home.
- [Courses](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/courses/): Education system courses — Bot Buddies (4-7), Code Kids (8-11), Code Quest (12-15), AI Lab (15-17), Career Launcher (18+).
- [Applications](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/applications/): Age-group hubs (4-7, 8-11, 12-15, 15-17, 18+).
- [Pomoflow](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/pomoflow/): Focus timer app.
- [Flashcard](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/flashcard/): Flashcard learning app.
- [Interview](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/interview/): AI interview prep app.
- [Jobtool](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/jobtool/): Job search helper tool.
- [Contact](https://rohitbhandariwork.github.io/#contact): Reach the builder.

## Notes

- Site name is "Rohit Builds"; older branding ("Education Reimagined", "RBPN") is retired.
- Personal brand only — the projects are demonstrations of a builder at work.
